name: Marina Kitchen
notes: Photo 1 is a spirits-by-the-pour list and was skipped as a drink-only menu. Photo 3 shows a menu for a different restaurant ('Sally's Waterfront Dining') misfiled in this listing's photos and was skipped entirely. Photos 2 and 4 are two different-era Marina Kitchen menus (a lunch-only sheet vs. a fuller all-day sheet) with overlapping items at slightly different prices; photo 4 (fuller, all-day) was used as the primary source for shared items, and items unique to photo 2 were merged in. Two items from photo 2 (Turkey Caesar Club, French Dip "Banh Mi") had their prices cut off by a shadow and are included without a price.
